instruction: Could you add subtitles to the video "/home/user/fullvideo.mp4" using GIMP? I need the text "Sample Video" to appear at the bottom from 1 to 3 seconds.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot edit or add subtitles to video files. While GIMP can add text to images, it does not have video timeline editing capabilities required for timed subtitles. This requires video editing software like Kdenlive or subtitle tools.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP is an image editor and cannot perform video editing operations
The instruction requires adding timed subtitles (1-3 seconds) to a video file, which requires video timeline editing capabilities
GIMP can only work with static images, not video files with temporal elements
The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible' function which is the appropriate evaluation for tasks that cannot be completed with the specified application
The explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible and suggests appropriate alternatives (Kdenlive, subtitle tools)
